recognize_zh: 淋巴球門控的 CD8 對 CD4 散點圖：紅色為 CD4+ 輔助 T 細胞，綠色為 CD8+ 細胞毒性 T 細胞，藍色族群 CD4 與 CD8 皆陰性；搭配前圖 CD3 亮陽性、CD5 弱陰性，判讀為 γδ T 細胞。
features: Lymphocyte-gated dot plot of CD8-ECD (x-axis) versus CD4-APC750 (y-axis)
Red population: CD4 positive, CD8 negative (helper T cells)
Green population: CD8 positive, CD4 negative, with a tight bright cluster and a trailing dimmer CD8 smear
Blue population: CD4/CD8 double-negative (the CD3-bright, CD5-dim cells on the companion plot)
Purple population: largely double-negative with a small dim CD4/CD8 diagonal smear, corresponding to CD3-negative B/NK cells
describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on lymphocytes displays CD8 versus CD4. Distinct CD4-positive (red) and CD8-positive (green) T-cell populations are present, the latter including a dimmer CD8 subset. A sizable blue population is negative for both CD4 and CD8; on the companion plot these cells are bright CD3-positive with dim to absent CD5. Purple events representing CD3-negative B and NK cells are mostly double-negative. The CD3+, CD5 dim, CD4−/CD8− phenotype of the blue population is most consistent with gamma-delta T cells, with confirmation by TCRγδ staining if a neoplastic process is suspected.

ddx.dx: Hepatosplenic or other gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Neoplastic gamma-delta cells form an expanded, uniform population with additional aberrancies (e.g. CD7 loss, CD56 gain) and clonal TCRG rearrangement, rather than a heterogeneous minor subset.
T-LGL is usually CD8+ with CD57/CD16 expression and aberrant CD5/CD7 dimming, whereas the blue cells lack CD8.

ddx.dx: Double-negative alpha-beta T cells in ALPS
ddx.vs: ALPS double-negative T cells are TCRαβ+ and elevated above ~2.5% of T cells, requiring TCRαβ/γδ staining to separate from gamma-delta cells.
